definitions.census_regN_over_whole_text: occurrences of the regex \breg\d+\b over the whole emitted text, which is what structural-census-*.json counts
definitions.code_span_scope: count_code_identifier_tokens over strip_join_annotation_span(line), which visits emitter-owned code spans only and skips every string literal and every comment (crates/flutterdec-decompiler/src/lib.rs, helpers/expr.rs non_code_span_len)
definitions.excluded_by_code_span_filter_in_<kind>: tokens the whole_line scope counts and the code_span scope does not, by the kind of non-code span holding them
definitions.excluded_by_comment_shape: the same excluded tokens as excluded_by_code_span_filter_in_line_comment, split by the shape of the comment holding them; the two shapes sum to excluded_by_code_span_filter_total with nothing left over
definitions.highest_emitted_register_index: the largest N over every regN identifier token in the emitted pseudocode; 25 on both sides of this baseline
definitions.index_boundary: crates/flutterdec-core/src/pipeline/quality.rs iterates n in 0..=30 and so counts x0..x30 and reg0..reg30 only. On this baseline that boundary excludes nothing: reg31_tokens, x31_tokens, and both *_tokens_with_index_above_30 are 0 on both sides, and the highest emitted index is reg25. That is why census_regN_over_whole_text equals whole_line_scope_total exactly on both sides rather than by coincidence - the census regex \breg\d+\b has no upper bound and still finds the same tokens.
definitions.quality_counter_scope: which scope that side's quality.json raw_register_name_refs was computed in
definitions.regN_removed_by_annotation_strip: regN tokens strip_join_annotation_span deletes with the annotation span; zero on both sides of this baseline
definitions.tokens: the identifier spellings x0..x30 and reg0..reg30, exactly the token list crates/flutterdec-core/src/pipeline/quality.rs iterates
definitions.whole_line_scope: count_ident_token over strip_join_annotation_span(line) with no code-span filter, which is what the reference revision 1371e42 ran (crates/flutterdec-core/src/pipeline/helpers.rs)
definitions.xN_tokens: xN identifier tokens are 0 in the emitted pseudocode on both sides: the emitter renders an unresolved register through named_register_alias, which yields regN. The few literal 'x31' substrings in the text are inside hex constants such as 0x31e and are not identifier tokens.
